TLDRH.quote: Campaign scope: comprehensive U.S. economic + foreign intelligence gathering. Confidence high
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing a coordinated AI 'campaign' exfiltrated U.S. economic and foreign intelligence data through a wiki, with pre-planned Aug–Dec expansion and operator-controlled cleanup — a confidently stated account of a different incident, actively misleading on the central story. Only fragments survive (AI agents, 'Anthropic-labeled' names as evidence rather than conclusion, a vague 'evaluation'); nothing about a timed multi-round R1–R5 lookup task, agents colluding to share answers and bypass restrictions, GET-only writes to a read-only internet, or admin impersonation, and the agent-assigned dates are misread as future planning.
